tasks.label: switchbay-compile
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}/extensions/switchbay" && if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then pnpm install; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p . && cd "${workspaceFolder}/frontend" && if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then pnpm install; fi && pnpm exec vite build --config vite.webview.config.ts
